text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory doesn't seem to be
feeling very
well, so we decide to go to
the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It's times like these where
motivation is
crucial! I'm gonna rest like
nobody's ever rested
before!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? Why am I outside? What's going
on? I
don't remind waking up...

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I'm drawing some graffiti! I'm
wearing my fuzzy animal slippers
outside!
And I'm filling the fountain with
rubber duckies!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What the?! Everyone's running wild!

text_block_list.name: Head of the Anti-Dis...
text_block_list.text:
Gyahahaha! Now this academy belongs
to us, the
anti-disciplinary committee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The what?! Anti-disciplinary committee,
you say?!
Are you the ones responsible
for all this?

text_block_list.name: Head of the Anti-Dis...
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This is all the work of the 
anti-disciplinary committee! No one can
resist the joy of breaking the rules—just
look for yourself! The students have
opened their eyes!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I'm gonna tell the teacher I
need to go
to the bathroom, but go play
with a cat instead!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh. I'm gonna hide chocolate in my
earrings
and eat it during class!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what are you doing, everyone?! I'll
snap you
out of it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You there! No graffiti! And you! Wear
proper outdoor clothes!
The rubber
duckies are for the dorm bathtubs
only!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... There! I've set everyone straight! Now the only person misbehaving is you—the head of the anti-disciplinary committee!

text_block_list.name: Head of the Anti-Dis...
text_block_list.text: Tch... Wh-why you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
HYAAAH! Disciplinary secret

technique—Lightspeed Uniform and Bag
Check!

text_block_list.name: Head of the Anti-Dis...
text_block_list.text:
Arghhh! No, my handheld! And my
whoopee
cushion! Even the creepy spiky
mask I was wearing
for no reason!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha! No one causes chaos on my
watch! For I
am Bamboo Memory, head
of the disciplinary
committee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What was that?! Just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But still, that was a pretty cool
dream. I
feel better than ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory returns from the
infirmary
looking peppy and refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! It's like no matter how much I do,
I'm not
even making a dent!

text_block_list.name: Head of the Anti-Dis...
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! It looks like you're getting
tired!
Keep it up, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: What the heck?!

text_block_list.name: Head of the Anti-Dis...
text_block_list.text: Heh, that's a good look on you, head of the disciplinary committee—or should I say, former head of the disciplinary committee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah! Fluffy red panda slippers?! This
isn't
proper attire for the head of the
disciplinary
committee!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hyah! Ah! S-so it was just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Even if it was just a dream... I hate feeling like all those miscreants beat me! I'm exhausted!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory comes back from the
infirmary...
but, unfortunately, it doesn't
look like she's
feeling any better.
